handoff.salientSummary: Implemented Reservations foundation auth, DO routing, security guards, serialized write gate, App access/token/context routes, role presets & implied permissions, sidebar/shell UI, idempotent US/KSA seed script, and ADR 048 + docs. All 80 new Reservations tests (56 in App, 24 in tenant-api), full workspace Vitest suites, Lingui check, typecheck, and live curl/browser checks passed.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
1. RBAC & Role Editor (VAL-FND-015): Added the 8 Reservations permissions, RESERVATIONS_IMPLIED_PERMISSION_IDS, withImpliedReservationsPermissions, and role presets (Host, Shift manager, General manager, Reservations manager, Guest relations, Guestbook manager, Finance, Owner, Viewer) in apps/app/app/utils/organization/tenant-role-permissions.ts and apps/app/app/utils/reservations/role-presets.ts, and gated the Reservations group and presets on reservations.enabled in TenantRoleAccessManager and all 4 role settings routes.
2. Operator Token Mint Route (VAL-FND-016): Implemented apps/app/app/utils/reservations/access.server.ts, token.server.ts, and GET /:orgSlug/reservations/token (routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+/token.ts) minting HS256 rsv+jwt tokens with aud 'tenant-api-reservations-operator', 900s/300s TTL, locationIds intersection with UserOrganization.locationScope, impersonation write/sensitive grant stripping, and regional tenantApiUrl resolution.
3. Tenant-API Auth, Guard & DO Routing (VAL-FND-017): Created apps/tenant-api/src/lib/http.ts, reservations-auth.ts, and reservations-guard.ts (rsvGuard), and updated workers/org-router.ts to route /operator/reservations* by operator JWT, /reservations/* by customer JWT or Origin+slug/host (never query/body orgId), and /internal/reservations/*, /api/reservations/*, and /api/voice/actions/* by JSON body orgId.
4. Control-Plane Context & Cache (VAL-FND-018): Created GET /resources/reservations/context in App and apps/tenant-api/src/lib/reservations-context.ts with 60s fresh TTL, 5-minute stale fallback on fetch error, and immediate invalidation via POST /internal/reservations/context-changed.
5. Serialized Per-Org Write Gate (VAL-FND-019): Created apps/tenant-api/src/lib/reservations-write.ts (and reservations-lock.ts) implementing withReservationWrite with runExclusive, retryOnSqliteBusy, in-transaction expired hold/payment/request/waitlist sweep, idempotency key check/store (409 on hash mismatch), loadDayStateInTx, bumpDayVersionsInTx, and day cache invalidation.
6. Router Scaffolds & Security Gate Tests (VAL-FND-020): Mounted reservationsOperatorRoutes, reservationsPublicRoutes, reservationsInternalRoutes, reservationsTickRoutes, and reservationsVoiceActionRoutes in apps/tenant-api/src/app.ts and added apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-security.test.ts and apps/app/app/utils/reservations/reservations-guards.test.ts.
7. App Sidebar & Shell Layout (VAL-FND-021, VAL-FND-022): Wired reservationsNav into apps/app/app/root.tsx and app-sidebar.tsx, and built routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+/ (_layout.tsx, _index.tsx, today.tsx, book.tsx, waitlist.tsx, guests.tsx, experiences.tsx, reports.tsx, settings.tsx) plus ReservationsClientProvider and useReservationsClient.
8. Idempotent Seed Script (VAL-FND-023): Created apps/tenant-api/scripts/seed-reservations.mjs and seed-reservations.ts seeding acme (US) and riyadh-grill (KSA) across LibSQL data.db, local D1, and US/KSA tenant SQLite databases.
9. Documentation (VAL-FND-024): Created docs/decisions/048-reservations-data-residency.md, docs/reservations.md, docs/reservations-contract.md, docs/reservations-plan.md, and updated docs/permissions.md.
